mostWorthwhile.text: The handset test exposed the hidden dependency on the company directory: the radios worked, but the clinic's address still had to be found. Fixing that dependency made the offline network feel meaningfully tested.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final water-service pairing was less clear than the test itself: I tried the rack, but the compatible partner was the handset.

surprise.text: I was surprised that an independent radio link could still depend on a company directory to locate the clinic.

arbitrary.text: The handset's exact pairing with the rack for the call test was not obvious to me; I expected to retry it with the radio link.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see what happens at migration after the rehearsal exposed and repaired a failure that a green indicator missed.
